$comment: Central paths + defaults for the walkthrough pipeline. ffmpegBin/ffprobeBin resolve in this order: env FFMPEG_BIN/FFPROBE_BIN -> this config -> PATH. Nothing here is generated; edit paths to match your environment.

higgsfield.$comment: Reference values only. Two generation paths: local key-based src/generate-clips.js (uses dopModel), or agent-driven MCP (docs/HIGGSFIELD_MCP.md, uses mcpVideoModel). build-shot-plan.js emits one spec per shot that maps onto either.
higgsfield.videoModelHint: cinematic_studio_video_v2 (fallback kling3_0); confirm via models_explore at run time

mcpVideoModelParams.$comment: Passed to the MCP generate_video (Cinema Studio v2) for steadier, more dynamic motion. speedramp=linear keeps constant velocity (no lurching); higher cfg_scale makes it obey the 'no shake' + lateral-move prompt more strictly; sound off (music added at assembly).
